Footer.description: Empowering the next generation of DNS administrators through hands-on, risk-free learning experiences.

About.mission-description: ZeroCentDNS is committed to democratizing {{highlight}}DNS education{{/highlight}}. We believe that everyone should have access to hands-on learning opportunities without financial barriers.
About.edufirst-description: Every feature is designed with learning in mind, providing clear feedback and educational resources.
About.efficiency-description: Clean, intuitive interface that focuses on what matters most - your learning experience.
About.community-driver-description: Built for and supported by the open-source community, students, and educational institutions.
About.partnership-details: Even the smallest step, taken together, can lead to great progress.

Hero.risk-free-description: ZeroCentDNS provides a safe educational environment to master DNS concepts through delegated subdomains. Perfect for students, developers, and businesses exploring DNS.

Features.edufocus-description: Designed specifically for learning DNS concepts in a safe, controlled environment.
Features.for-everyone-description: Perfect for students, developers, open-source community, and small businesses.
Features.full-dns-control-description: Practice configuring A, AAAA, MX, CNAME, and other DNS record types.
Features.6month-description: Each subdomain remains active for 6 months, ensuring efficient resource usage.
Features.nocost-description: No cost, no commitment. Learn without the fear of breaking production systems.
Features.handson-description: Get practical experience before investing in your own top-level domain.
Features.why-description: A comprehensive platform designed to make DNS learning accessible, practical, and completely free for everyone.
